create_QuarkConfig: create a QuarkConfig from a quantization config dict with kv_cache_group and pack_method parameters
get_QuarkLinearMethod: get a QuarkLinearMethod instance for applying Quark quantization to linear layers
get_QuarkFusedMoEMethod: get a QuarkFusedMoEMethod instance for applying Quark quantization to fused MoE layers
apply_QuarkLinearMethod: apply QuarkLinearMethod forward pass to a quantized linear layer with input tensor and optional bias
create_QuarkKVCacheMethod: create a QuarkKVCacheMethod to load kv-cache scaling factors from Quark checkpoints with fp8_e4m3 per_tensor quantization
